content: Schema-block extraction pattern for src/warren-config: (1) define the zod schema + exported constants in a new <name>-config.ts; (2) schema.ts adds import + alphabetically-sorted re-export + one commented .optional() field, keeping its line count under the frozen 504 budget; (3) classify the new DefaultsConfig key as public or redacted in src/server/handlers/projects.warren-config.ts (warren-b754 allowlists) or check:coverage fails; (4) sibling tests co-locate as <name>-config.test.ts with describe('<unit>') and verb-led test names.

name: zod-v4-targeted-object-error
description: Rejecting a zod v4 boolean shorthand with a custom hint: an object-level string error: param overrides the strict unrecognized_keys message too. Use the function form error: (issue) => issue.code === 'invalid_type' ? 'hint' : undefined so only the type failure gets the hint (pr.autoMerge true shorthand rejection, warren-6c5a).
